data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'aletheia', meaning 'truth' or 'sincerity'. In ancient Greek culture, 'aletheia' was personified as a goddess, symbolizing the concept of truth and sincerity. The name Alithia carries the meaning “Truth, sincerity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alithia usually hope their child will grow to embody truth, sincerity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
